name: @khorsheed/dsh-quote
description: Quote anything: selecting text pops an action menu — quote into the current session (to the composer), quote into a side chat (as a side-chat ref), copy; other plugins register their own action rows through the ctx.quoteActions registry, and the side-chat item hides when sidechat is absent

compat.notes: 引用任意内容 is a web-only selection overlay: its one surface rides the frame-wide `shell.overlay` list seat (ui-layout's frame, present on every shipped web line) through ctx.slots.inject, so a host without the seat simply never mounts the menu and a headless profile has nothing to mount at all. The selection read is the repo's last-resort DOM anchor: it reads ONLY window.getSelection()'s selected plain text plus its bounding rect (never host DOM structure or class names — the one structural check is the editable-element exclusion the gesture itself requires); when a host redesign defeats the read, the menu silently never appears (zero breakage, re-verified by hand on each host adaptation).「引用到当前会话」drives the official conversation input machine (ctx.sessions.scope(id).get('conversation').input.for(scope), the ui-shortcuts/message-tools precedent) and hides without a current session; a host without the conversation service degrades to a silent no-op. On hosts with the insert-reference seam (the `slash/input-insert-reference` scoped bail event plus the `inputTriggers` service, 0.2.x) the insert is a structured reference chip serialized at submit by this plugin's own codec (a headless trigger source, registered through a deferred ctx.inject arm since client mount order is unconstrained, never a hard inject); a composition without the service or a declined span falls back to the merged plain-text blockquote, so older hosts behave exactly as before — note a chip left in a draft after uninstall blocks that draft's send by host design (delete the chip). Sent messages render the quote as a styled card through the `quote-block` UserTextRule plus the keyed `conversation.user.text.node` seat (0.2.x); a host without the userText registry keeps the raw wire text. Room sessions quote into the room composer directly once the room plugin's composer draft rides the official machine (2026-10); under an older room plugin the quote lands in the hidden official draft (looks like a no-op) and upgrading room fixes it.「引用到侧边对话」hides when the sidechat Remote namespace is absent, and the route itself rides this package's own thin typert Remote (namespace `quote`, verb `addRef`) whose host half probes ctx.get('sideChat') and calls openWith — the sanctioned host-to-host seam, structural mirror only, declared in dsh.references, never a dependency; without the side-chat service the verb refuses 'unavailable' and the click no-ops silently.
